notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP - curl_cffi impersonate=chrome110 against www.westside.com (Shopify storefront). robots.txt checked first: User-agent: * / Allow: / (no Claude/anthropic-ai block, no full-site Disallow), fully permitted. All pages returned 200; no blocks encountered, tier (a) sufficed for the whole pass. TREE METHOD: built from the site's mega-menu 'Home' vertical (mobile menu-drawer markup in homepage HTML, which mirrors the desktop mega-menu in this Shopify Dawn theme) cross-checked against sitemap_collections_1.xml. Home vertical has exactly 4 subsections: Living, Kitchen, Bed, Bath (apparel/Brand/Gift-Shop menus out of scope per brief). Confirmed each leaf's identity via its og:title/page <title> tag matching the expected category before recording. QTY METHOD: each collection page embeds a client-side var 'productCount: parseInt("NN")' (iWish/wishlist widget init) which reflects the page's true rendered product count; used as the qty evidence source since no server-rendered 'X products' text or products_count JSON field was present in the raw HTML. EXCLUDED and why: 'View All' and 'New In' under Home/Living/Kitchen/Bed/Bath - cross-cut aggregation pages, not standalone subcategory nodes (rule: View All/Collections excluded). Living>Decor, Candle|Stands, Home Fragrance, Flowers|Vases, Plants|Planters, Lights|Lanterns - decorative accessories/candles/plants/lighting, out of Textile+Storage scope per textile.md SS23 and general Lighting/Decorative-Accessories boundary. Kitchen>Bottles, Tea|Coffee, Serveware, Kitchenware - Kitchen & Dining products, not textile/storage. /collections/textile (194 products) found in sitemap but NOT linked from mega-menu nav - a rollup/aggregation of all textile products across Living/Kitchen/Bed/Bath; excluded under the Parent-Category-URL rule (textile.md SS25) since its constituent subcategories are already recorded individually. /collections/home-kitchen-storage found in sitemap with productCount=0 and NOT linked from mega-menu nav - orphaned/unused collection, excluded (no qualifying products, not part of live navigation). Bath>Bath Accessories (18 products) is a mixed collection: per-product 'type' taxonomy and product descriptions embedded in the page (Shopify analytics meta + JSON-LD) show 14/18 items explicitly typed 'Laundry Baskets' with descriptions using storage/organisation language ('roomier storage', 'everyday organisation'), while the remaining ~4 are decorative 'Bath Accessories Set' soap-dish/soap-dispenser items; the collection itself is titled/SEO-framed around 'Soap Dispenser' rather than storage. Recorded as Storage with LOW confidence and a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than dropped, since the majority of concrete products and the site's own per-product classification point to storage/organisation per storage.md SS42 ambiguity tie-breakers (product description + website's own type classification); qty=18 reflects the whole collection as displayed since no site-provided sub-filter isolates the 14 basket-only items. No other storage-labeled category exists anywhere in the Home vertical nav or sitemap (no Storage, Organizers, Wardrobe-storage, Shoe-storage, Pantry-storage nodes found) - consistent with brief expectation that storage is thin/absent for this apparel-led retailer. No duplicate URLs recorded; no product-detail/search/collection-rollup URLs used.
